unit: Unit 12: Everyday Life with Your Computer
title: Calendar and Reminders
drDigitalIntro:
A digital calendar keeps your schedule organized and syncs across all your devices automatically.

1. Open the Calendar app on your computer or phone.
2. Tap or click a day — for example, a day next week.
3. Tap the + button (or double-click the day) to create a new event.
4. Type a name for your event, such as 'Doctor appointment'.
5. Set the start time and end time using the time pickers.
6. Tap Save — the event will appear on all your devices.

For reminders:
1. Open the Reminders (or Clock) app.
2. Tap + to add a new reminder.
3. Type what you need to remember, such as 'Buy milk'.
4. Optionally set a date and time so your device alerts you.
5. Tap Save, then tick the circle when the task is done.

Tip: Color-code your calendars — use one color for personal events and another for appointments. It makes your week easier to read at a glance.
drDigitalSuccess: Your schedule is now in your computer, not just in your head! Calendars and reminders mean nothing important gets forgotten.
drDigitalHint: Open the Calendar app, tap a day, then tap + to add an event. Give it a name and a time, then save it.
